hints.title: Exploiting Sorted Order with Bisection
hints.text: Because the array of characters is non-decreasing, locating the smallest item strictly greater than target can be resolved logarithmically.

hints.title: Handling Circular Array Wrap-Around
hints.text: If every character in the array is less than or equal to target, the result wraps around cyclically to the very first character.

hints.title: Bisection Right with Modulo Indexing
hints.text: Maintain search bounds low and high. If letters[mid] <= target, narrow to the right half; otherwise narrow to the left half. Return letters[low % len(letters)].

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of characters in letters
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving logarithmic O(log N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning takes O(N) time and fails to exploit the pre-sorted property.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bisection search achieves logarithmic time without auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle the modulo wrap-around cleanly when target equals or exceeds all elements.
